FIELDS.NAME: Golden Crust Bakery
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Compliance Manager, Golden Crust Bakery, 1234 Doughnut Drive, Suite 100, Bakeville, NY 12345-6789, (555) 123-4567, john.doe@goldencrustbakery.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Golden Crust Bakery is a retail bakery specializing in freshly baked goods, including a variety of bagels, pastries, cakes, and breads made daily on the premises. Our operations prioritize food safety and customer satisfaction, with all staff trained in food handling and sanitation practices, adhering to ServSafe certification standards. We operate with monitored fire and burglar alarm systems to protect our customers and employees, coupled with automatic extinguishing systems positioned over all cooking equipment, significantly reducing fire risks. Our primary focus is on maintaining excellent sanitation and refrigeration controls to ensure the quality and safety of our baked products. Additionally, we source ingredients exclusively from reputable suppliers, ensuring consistent quality and traceability. Golden Crust Bakery prides itself on providing a welcoming environment for our customers, with a focus on quality, safety, and service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/10/2023, we experienced a minor water damage incident due to a plumbing issue, resulting in an estimated loss of $3,000. The damage was promptly addressed and restored to full operational capacity within one week. The incident has been closed, and all necessary repairs and preventive measures have been implemented.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1, UL Listed Fire Safe.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored fire and burglar alarm systems, along with automatic extinguishing systems over all cooking equipment, ensure comprehensive protection against fire and theft risks.

Our focus is solely on producing baked goods while maintaining compliance with food safety regulations.

FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Golden Crust Bakery does not lease employees to or from other employers, as all staff are directly employed by the bakery to ensure consistency in training and quality of service.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Golden Crust Bakery carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance and protect our employees in case of work-related injuries. This policy is active and meets all legal requirements.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Golden Crust Bakery does not own or operate any other businesses. We focus solely on our operations as a retail bakery specializing in freshly baked goods.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Golden Crust Bakery does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All coverage is sufficiently managed under the current policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Golden Crust Bakery is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we focus exclusively on retailing freshly baked goods made on the premises.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Golden Crust Bakery does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our focus is on providing fresh baked goods exclusively for retail sales on our premises.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Golden Crust Bakery has not had any foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens during the past five years. The business has maintained a positive financial standing since its inception.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Golden Crust Bakery does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond what is typically found in the operations of a bakery, which primarily focuses on baking and food preparation. All safety measures and protocols are in place to mitigate any potential risks.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Golden Crust Bakery does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are focused on producing baked goods without significant risks associated with environmental or catastrophic events. We prioritize safety with proper measures in place, including fire suppression and compliance with safety protocols.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Golden Crust Bakery has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business operates with a strong commitment to compliance and ethical practices.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Golden Crust Bakery currently has no uncorrected fire code violations. All safety systems are in place and regularly maintained to ensure compliance.

reviews: Golden Crust Bakery has the best bagels in town! Freshly baked every morning, they are always soft and delicious.
I love their pastries! The chocolate croissants are a must-try, flaky and filled with rich chocolate.
The staff is super friendly and always ready to help. Plus, the coffee pairs perfectly with their baked goods.
I appreciate their commitment to food safety and quality. It's nice to know they prioritize customer health.
The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it a great spot to enjoy a quick breakfast or catch up with friends.
